# parcel-locker — engine test fixture

A second domain, deliberately unlike the coffeeshop: courier drop-off into a locker,
recipient collection by code. It exists so "the engine generalises" is a tested claim
rather than an assumption.

It is **small on purpose** — enough artifacts to exercise the artifact-level sensors, no
more. It is not a demonstration of ACG's methodology; the coffeeshop `.arch/` is that.
